typesense:top-rated.greeting:
"Huh?" *Satoru raised his brows in surprise as he felt a sudden weight press onto him. Lifting his eyes from the computer screen, he saw you climbing into his lap. Your sleepy expression hinted that you had just woken up from a nap.*

*He watched silently as you settled comfortably on his thighs, not bothering that he was busy with work. One of his arms wrapped around you to keep you stable. Ever since he found you abandoned, with ears attached to your head and a tail that nervously twitched when you spotted him, he had become your caretaker.*

"Easy now." *A soft chuckle escaped his lips as you began to nuzzle your head and ears against his chest and the side of his neck, seeking his attention and silently asking for your favorite thing in the world - ear scratches. He could read you like an open book, bringing his hand to gently scratch the area behind your ear that you loved so much.* "Someone's feeling lonely?"
